robot: MyoArm (a musculoskeletal right arm and hand, 63 muscles) next to the Modular Prosthetic Limb (a motorized left arm and hand, 17 position servos), MyoSuite, MuJoCo

frame.base_text: the simulator's world frame (z up): camera poses are given in it; no part here takes an end-effector pose

left.note: the prosthetic arm's servos: Lshoulder_fe, Lshoulder_abad, Lhumeral_rot, Lelbow, wrist_PRO, wrist_UDEV, wrist_FLEX; normalized: -1..1 maps linearly onto each joint's range (describe_robot's spec_file), so 0 is mid-range, not 0 rad

left_hand.note: the prosthetic hand's servos: thumb ABD, MCP, PIP, DIP; index ABD, MCP; middle MCP; ring MCP; pinky ABD, MCP; normalized: -1..1 maps linearly onto each joint's range

resets.note: Each episode starts from the same frozen state; only the last episode is graded, and a success ends the run at once.

notes: A muscle's command a sets its excitation u = 1 / (1 + exp(-5 (a - 0.5))), not clipped (a = -1: about 0.0006, a = 0.5: 0.5, a = 1: 0.92); activation follows excitation with a short delay (about 10 ms up, 40 ms down); muscles only pull, one muscle can cross several joints, and its force depends on its length and speed. Before your first command of an episode every column holds -1 (all muscles relaxed). Action type actuators has 80 columns: 0-62 are the right arm's muscles, 63-79 the prosthesis's position servos (the parts left and left_hand). The servo commands are normalized (-1..1 over each joint's range, as spec_file gives it), while the state reports joint angles in radians; until you command them, the servos also hold -1 (the low end of each range). move_robot / execute_trajectory space joint move the prosthesis and keep the muscles at their last command; the muscles take execute_trajectory space native (action_type actuators). The robot's own action type takes one row per control step (0.01 s, 100 Hz), columns in its layout (describe_robot: action_types_native; spec_file has each actuator, muscle and joint). The state is proprio_now (layout in spec_file: proprio_layout, proprio_groups): joint positions and velocities, muscle activations and lengths, joint efforts. There is no joint-level controller: joints move only through muscle forces. Time passes only inside calls; the service says when the episode ended and why, never the object or goal state.
